key: You're... Have... I been found?
en: You're... Have... I been found?
ja: きみは……　ぼくは……　見つけてもらえたのか?

key: It's been so long. I thought I would die down here...
en: It's been so long. I thought I would die down here...
ja: ずいぶん 長かった　ここで 死ぬのかと 思ってた……

key: Some time ago, I was walking with my girlfriend in Obsidia, and this huge vine just lashed up through the ground and pulled me down here.
en: Some time ago, I was walking with my girlfriend in Obsidia, and this huge vine just lashed up through the ground and pulled me down here.
ja: 少し前 オブシディアで 恋人と 歩いていたら　地面から 巨大なツルが 突き出して ここまで 引きずりこまれたんだ

key: Thank you so much for finding me!
en: Thank you so much for finding me!
ja: 見つけてくれて 本当に ありがとう!

key: I couldn't move past all this debris, but---
en: I couldn't move past all this debris, but---
ja: このガレキで 先へ 進めなかったけど——

key: I have to find her!
en: I have to find her!
ja: 彼女を 探さなきゃ!

key: I don't have much strength, but I think I can get out of here now.
en: I don't have much strength, but I think I can get out of here now.
ja: 力は あまり 残ってないけど　もう ここから 出られると思う

key: Thank-- thank you so much!
en: Thank-- thank you so much!
ja: ほ 本当に ありがとう!

key: ARC: You got the lowdown, right?
en: ARC: You got the lowdown, right?
ja: アーク: 話は 聞いているな?

key: I've got a radio comm' here, and the others have the receiving piece.
en: I've got a radio comm' here, and the others have the receiving piece.
ja: こちらに 無線機がある　ほかの者は 受信機を 持っている

key: When I send the signal, we'll bust in at the same time.
en: When I send the signal, we'll bust in at the same time.
ja: 私が 合図を 送ったら 全員 同時に 突入する

key: If the information I got was true, we might be in for a lot of tough battles.
en: If the information I got was true, we might be in for a lot of tough battles.
ja: 情報が 正しければ 厳しい戦いが 続くだろう

key: But if we can do this, then we can end everything right here, and right now.
en: But if we can do this, then we can end everything right here, and right now.
ja: だが やり遂げれば すべてを 今ここで 終わらせられる

key: That means once we go in, there may not be any turning back.
en: That means once we go in, there may not be any turning back.
ja: つまり 入ったら もう 引き返せないかもしれない

key: So make absolutely sure you're ready first.
en: So make absolutely sure you're ready first.
ja: だから 必ず 準備を 整えてから 行くんだ

key: You set to do this?
en: You set to do this?
ja: 覚悟は いいか?

key: ARC: Good.
en: ARC: Good.
ja: アーク: よし

key: You go ahead. I'll radio the others and be right behind you.
en: You go ahead. I'll radio the others and be right behind you.
ja: 先に 行け　ほかの者に 無線を 入れて すぐ 追いつく

key: ARC: That's fine. The others will wait for my signal.
en: ARC: That's fine. The others will wait for my signal.
ja: アーク: かまわない　ほかの者は 私の合図を 待っている

key: Rest now so you can keep tempo when it counts.
en: Rest now so you can keep tempo when it counts.
ja: 今のうちに 休んでおけ　いざという時に ついてこられるようにな

key: ARC: You go ahead. I'll radio the others and be right behind you.
en: ARC: You go ahead. I'll radio the others and be right behind you.
ja: アーク: 先に 行け　ほかの者に 無線を 入れて すぐ 追いつく

key: VICTORIA: You're here.
en: VICTORIA: You're here.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 来ましたね

key: Our entrance is right behind us.
en: Our entrance is right behind us.
ja: わたしたちの 突入口は すぐ 後ろです

key: Arclight has the signal, so talk to him when you're ready.
en: Arclight has the signal, so talk to him when you're ready.
ja: 合図は アークライトが 持っています　準備ができたら 話しかけてください

key: VICTORIA: I'm with you, \PN.
en: VICTORIA: I'm with you, \PN.
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしも 一緒です \PN

key: It'll be just like when we were fighting together before, right?
en: It'll be just like when we were fighting together before, right?
ja: 前に 一緒に 戦った時と 同じですね?

key: Only this time, I'll make sure the scales are tipped in our favor.
en: Only this time, I'll make sure the scales are tipped in our favor.
ja: ただし 今度は 天びんを こちらに 傾けてみせます

key: The metal pole is tall and rickety. A Pokémon could probably shake it.
en: The metal pole is tall and rickety. A Pokémon could probably shake it.
ja: 金属のポールは 高く ぐらついている。ポケモンなら 揺らせそうだ。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
